title: Exponential Regularization
body: Namjoon is experimenting with regularization functions, and he wants to explore an exponential regularization function Pow($$\theta$$):\n\n$$\text{Pow}(\theta) $$=$$ $$\lambda$$ \sum_{i=1}**{p} 10**{\theta_i}$$
lesson: Copy of Regularization and Cross Validation
